findings.summary: R1 requires accepting plan_package_final.json plus its associated structured handoff bundle as canonical planning input, but the architecture/interface contracts are not consistent about the handoff bundle (some contracts list only plan_package_final.json + repo_context.json + workspace_context.json). This could weaken traceability of required upstream handoff materials at intake.

evidence.note: R1 text explicitly includes the associated structured handoff bundle
evidence.quote: The Implementation Council subsystem SHALL accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json (plus its associated structured handoff bundle)...

evidence.note: IF1 input contract omits the structured handoff bundle
evidence.quote: Provide plan_package_final.json + repo_context.json + workspace_context.json; receive intake_result.json...

evidence.note: Chosen O1 high-level dataflow omits the structured handoff bundle

findings.summary: R3 says workspace_context.json MUST be required before any workspace-writing stage begins, but the Intake stage tool policy allows workspace_write (non-canonical) even though Intake is also the stage that validates/collects workspace_context.json. The plan does not explicitly state that workspace_context validation occurs before any allowed Intake workspace_write, creating a potential policy/ordering gap.

evidence.note: R3 requires workspace_context.json before any workspace-writing stage begins
evidence.quote: workspace_context.json SHALL be required before any workspace-writing stage begins...

evidence.note: Intake restrictions allow workspace_write before the plan explicitly establishes validation ordering

findings.summary: R3/R2 depend on deterministic schema validation enforcement, but the WorkPlanning stage policy is internally inconsistent about workspace writes (allowlisted_tools omits workspace_write while restrictions specify workspace_write behavior). This ambiguity may complicate deterministic enforcement/validation sequencing for context prerequisites.

evidence.note: WorkPlanning allowlisted tools do not include workspace_write
WorkPlanning restrictions specify workspace_write behavior despite not being allowlisted
